notes.title: 📢 Butcher Life Demo Coming Soon! 🥩
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 👋[/p][p]I’m excited to share that a [b]demo version of [i]Butcher Life[/i][/b] is on its way and will be available to play this [b]October during Steam Next Fest[/b]. This will be the first opportunity for players to experience the world of [i]Butcher Life[/i], where you start small and slowly build your countryside butcher empire.[/p][p]Right now, I’m working hard to make sure the game is ready on time. Many new features have already been added, including:[/p][p][/p][h3]🛠 Gameplay & Progression[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Central Abattoir[/b] → A brand-new slaughterhouse where players must go to purchase all their meat before processing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/e985bae54233c620c8673920b9708bdb06f0adc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]    [/p][p][b]Pawn Shop[/b] → Buy decorative and useful items, or sell anything you find around the world maybe even hidden treasures waiting to be discovered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/b9c856401d35938fa475a0c065c1f4c4d78a111b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Container Auctions[/b] → Three containers will be available at a time, ranging from cheap to very expensive. What’s inside? Could be trash, could be something valuable  it’s up to you to take the risk.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/19c5b1d65d470e6d41a9440a36f68bf0d6d5b560.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Car Shop[/b] → Already implemented and ready for the full release. In the demo, you won’t be able to buy cars yet, but they’ll play a big role later in your journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/38b68ce67dcf3f374de2c525a2a89d74141333ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Weather System[/b] → Different weather conditions to challenge you as you work and deliver your products.[/p][list][*][p][b]Four Seasons[/b] → Each playthrough can start with a random season for a unique experience. Expect sunny days, autumn leaves, rainy weather, and even snow for a wonderful winter atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/d4ed66aa23f37f2fe57034ca5fb19c2684aacf20.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🍗 Variety in Products[/h3][list][*][p][b]Different Meat Types[/b] → Chicken, beef, lamb, (with more like fish planned for the future)..[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processed Products[/b] → Not just raw meat, but sausages, kebabs, smoked meat, jerky, etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Orders[/b] → Restaurants sometimes want a rare cut or specific recipe.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663894/7ab6299646e9a440142974128b9c406f1d83893e.png"][/img][/p][h3]
💰 Business Expansion[/h3][list][*][p][b]Butcher Shop Management[/b] → In the full release, hire workers, serve customers, and decorate your shop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Restaurant Contracts[/b] → Secure steady income, but remember: deadlines and quality matter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Competition[/b] → Rival butchers in town will push you to improve your reputation, prices, and product quality.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🚚 Long-Term Goals[/h3][list][*][p]Start in a [b]small House[/b]→ Upgrade to a [b]butcher shop[/b] → Expand into a [b]meat empire[/b] (delivery trucks, storage).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]The demo will give you a taste of the [b]story mode[/b] with the core gameplay loop:
Processing meat, selling it to restaurants, exploring the new systems like the pawn shop, Central Abattoir, and containers.[/p][p]Later, in the full release, you’ll unlock much more: running your butcher shop, managing workers, buying cars, and truly expanding your business.[/p][p]This is just the beginning, and I can’t wait for you to try it. Mark your calendars for [b]October[/b], wishlist [i]Butcher Life[/i], and get ready for a unique countryside adventure.[/p][p][b]Thank you for all your support![/b] 🙏
[/p]
